admission.justification: Without the rerun and the repeated search, a Reviewer passes a freeze whose recorded list omits a test that names the changed text, and the omission surfaces only after both lanes have passed.

applicability: Every baseline review and every fix-verification round a Reviewer opens on a leaf.
conditions: The Worker's freeze recorded the names it searched and the file list it ran.
The repeated search runs on the frozen candidate, not on a working tree that has moved past it.
exclusions: A clean sync that sends no freeze and opens no round.
A record-only repair whose candidate bytes are identical, which is checked on the last recorded round.

evidence: Reviewer reran the recorded 36-file list (511 passed, 1478 subtests) and repeated the search on the frozen candidate with no unrun match; reader B answer in worker evidence/reader-grades.md

statement: A Reviewer in a baseline review reruns the Worker's recorded focused-test list and repeats its search on the frozen candidate; a test file the search finds that the Worker did not run is a finding.
